column2: [intro]
I am an unpretentious melody
No need for great performances, it's my mission
I admire other singers
But me, I just prefer to make you smile
I never wanted to be a virtuoso
For me, simplicity is the thing that is required
I sing my songs with a smile on my lips
Just to make people laugh, to make the world lighter
My words are light as a feather
Laughter is the magic potion, it's my cold
I don't need high-flying musical acrobatics
Just a little humor for everyone to escape
I never wanted to be a virtuoso
For me, simplicity is the thing that is required
I sing my songs with a smile on my lips
Just to make people laugh, to make the world lighter
[ solo ]
So come dance, sing and laugh
Let yourself be carried away by my lightness
In this world sometimes too serious
I'm here to make you laugh, that's my wish
[outro]
